description: Defines the IObservableGrain interface in the UnitTests.GrainInterfaces namespace, specifying asynchronous methods for grain operations including value streaming and lifecycle controls.

classes.name: IObservableGrain
classes.description: An interface representing a grain capable of returning observable streams and managing grain lifecycle operations.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Signals grain to complete its processing.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Signals grain to fail or encounter an error.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Sends the next piece of data to the observer.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves an asynchronous stream of string values.

methods.name: GetValuesWithError
methods.description: Retrieves an asynchronous stream of integers, with the possibility to induce an error at a specified index.

methods.name: GetIncomingCalls
methods.description: Returns a list of incoming calls (interface and method names) received by the grain.
